text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae conquered the Tokyo 
Daishoten. Her rivals congratulated her, 
promising that they would keep running 
together in the races to come!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing her run, Hokko Tarumae 
returned to the Trainer's side. The 
Trainer's welcoming words struck a deep 
chord in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she expressed her heartfelt gratitude. 
To her fans, her rivals, and her 
"hometown"— it was thanks to everyone that 
she could stand here today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. Hokko Tarumae was named the URA 
Best Dirt Umamusume. Smart Falcon thanked 
her, saying it had reignited the fire in 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Hokko Tarumae is entrusted with the 
mission of claiming victory in the Dubai 
dirt International GⅠ. Next, she sets out 
to bring Tomakomai's sparkle to the 
world—!
